name: IDE Chile
description: Public geospatial services of Chile as one-click layers: the Geoportal de Chile (IDE Chile), IDE MINAGRI, IDE MINVU and the INE's Censuses 2024 and 2017. Boundaries, soils, land use, wetlands, hydrography, urban planning, census data, roads, schools and more, as map images or as features you can query. CUT tools join any table of Chile to its communes, provinces or regions by their código único territorial, assign communes to points and complete codes and names.
author: Daniel Díaz

tools.name: Join Table by CUT
tools.summary: Joins a CSV table to communes, provinces or regions by their código único territorial (CUT) or their name: codes with or without the leading zero, names however they are spelt, and the codes of before Ñuble (2018) and Arica y Parinacota and Los Ríos (2007). The table may be semicolon-separated and in Windows-1252, with decimal commas.

params.name: layer
params.label: Layer of communes, provinces or regions
params.help: A layer with a CUT or name field: Census 2024 › Communes, Provinces or Regions, or any other.

params.name: table
params.label: Table (CSV)
params.help: A CSV file with a column of CUT codes or names, as the INE, SINIM, CASEN, Servel or DEIS publish them.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.help: Whether the codes and names are communes, provinces or regions. Auto tells from the layer.

params.name: layer_key
params.label: Key field in the layer
params.help: The field holding the CUT code (1101 or 01101) or the name. Blank: the tool finds it.

params.name: table_key
params.label: Key column in the table
params.help: The column holding the CUT code or the name. Blank: the tool finds it.

params.name: keep_unmatched
params.label: Keep features without a row
params.help: Off: the result has only the features the table has a row for.

tools.name: Assign Commune to Points
tools.summary: Gives each point the commune, province and region it falls in, with their CUT codes and names, from a layer of communes (Census 2024 › Communes, or provinces or regions).

params.name: points
params.label: Points
params.help: Addresses, stations, premises… in the same coordinate system as the communes.

params.name: communes
params.label: Communes, provinces or regions
params.help: Census 2024 › Communes gives all three levels; a layer of provinces or regions gives its own and above.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.help: Whether the codes and names are communes, provinces or regions. Auto tells from the layer.

params.name: key
params.label: Key field in the polygons
params.help: The field holding the CUT code (1101 or 01101) or the name. Blank: the tool finds it.

tools.name: Complete CUT
tools.summary: Adds the current CUT code and the official names of the commune, province and region to a layer that has a code or name field, however it is written: 4 or 5 digits, old codes, other spellings.

params.name: layer
params.label: Layer
params.help: Any layer with a field of CUT codes or of commune, province or region names.

params.name: key
params.label: Key field
params.help: The field holding the CUT code (1101 or 01101) or the name. Blank: the tool finds it.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.help: Whether the codes and names are communes, provinces or regions. Auto tells from the layer.
